items.title: 61531_Juan Tizol oral history interview
items.q: When I joined Duke Ellington in the Cotton Club... and the bass player was that fellow from New Orleans... Wilmon Brough?

ctx.x: When I joined Duke Ellington in the Cotton Club, it was Arthur Whetsol, Freddie Wetzel, Phil Jenkins, Cootie Williams, Freddie Guy, a guitar player, and we had Otto Hardwick, Hiwork, saxophone, Johnny Hodges, and Carney, and on the drums was Sonny Greer, and the bass player was that fellow from New Orleans, what's his name?
